project_info.theme: Adult fashion portrait segmented by stacked fictional mobile browser windows
project_info.creative_direction: Hybrid composition combining a realistic studio photograph, deep volumetric lighting, and clean flat UI graphics
project_info.color_palette: rich red satin, neutral white, dark charcoal matte UI, soft skin tones, and subtle gray interface accents

main_subject.detail: approved adult fashion model with natural facial texture and direct camera gaze
main_subject.wardrobe: elegant red satin evening gown with gathered bodice, matching draped sleeve, and small black evening clutch with fictional floral detail
main_subject.pose: full-body centered portrait with graceful fluid posture, one hand near the collarbone, and head and feet fully within frame

composition_elements.framing: straight eye-level full-body view, 50mm-equivalent proportions, vertically segmented into four overlapping white browser windows
composition_elements.ui_layer: photographic image sits beneath four clean white rectangular mobile-browser elements, each slightly angled and containing fictional sample text such as sample.social/portrait; outside windows is solid uniform charcoal gray with no light bleed
composition_elements.interface: clean top bars with close icons and fictional URL text, plus visible bottom controls labeled Private, plus, and Done in generic UI
composition_elements.segmentation: each window reveals a different section of the same adult subject while preserving exact face, outfit, body proportions, and continuity

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: volumetric soft directional studio source at approximately 4800K with controlled side fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: deep realistic shadows and fabric folds on the subject, crisp separation from a flat white backdrop, and subtle screen-capture grain

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame camera with 50mm lens, photoreal studio fashion image under flat digital UI overlay
technical_specs.finish: natural skin texture, rich satin detail, clean segmentation, consistent charcoal UI color, and restrained contrast

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a full-body, centered portrait of a clearly adult woman with an approved fictional adult face reference, standing against a seamless pure high-key white studio backdrop and staring directly at the camera. Dress her in an elegant red satin evening gown with a gathered bodice, matching draped sleeve, and a small black evening clutch with fictional floral detail. Light her with volumetric studio lighting that creates deep definitions, realistic shadows, and strong three-dimensional quality on her body and fabric folds while keeping the background completely flat and shadowless. Digitally layer the entire photographic image beneath four distinct clean white rectangular mobile browser windows stacked vertically and angled slightly, segmenting the subject. Each window bar contains sharp fictional text such as sample.social/portrait. The area outside the active windows is a solid uniform dark charcoal gray matte UI frame with no light bleed or gradients. Add clean generic controls Private, plus, and Done at the bottom. Use a straight eye-level 50mm-equivalent view, ensure head and feet remain within the frame, preserve exact adult identity and outfit continuity, and add subtle digital noise to mimic a screen capture. Do not use real platform URLs, logos, handles, or public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, celebrity likeness, real social URL, real platform logo, real handle, watermark, floor shadows, flat subject lighting, 2D look, inconsistent UI color, bleeding colors, HDR, oversharpened, plastic skin, extra fingers, deformed hands, broken window segmentation, illegible UI text
